project.title: Rollout of New Outpatient Check-in and Triage Process
project.objective: Design and roll out a standardized outpatient check-in and triage process to reduce waiting times and improve data quality across the clinic.
deliverables: Documented end-to-end outpatient check-in and triage workflow
Standardized patient intake and consent forms
Triage nursing protocol and escalation guidelines
Front-desk and nursing staff training materials
Quality control checklist for daily process audits
constraints: Process must comply with health data protection and clinical regulations
No disruption to existing appointments during core hours
Limited budget for new tools; prioritize existing office and EHR systems
Forms must be available in at least two languages
Go-live must align with scheduled EHR maintenance window
Training must be delivered in short sessions to accommodate shifts
stakeholders: IT and electronic health record support

risks.risk: Front-desk and nursing staff resist changes to established routines.
risks.mitigation: Involve staff in workflow design, run pilot, collect feedback, and adjust before full rollout.

risks.risk: New forms or triage steps increase check-in time instead of reducing it.
risks.mitigation: Time-box pilot, measure average check-in duration, simplify forms and steps where needed.

risks.risk: Non-compliance with health data protection or consent requirements.
risks.mitigation: Review forms and workflow with compliance officer and update training to stress key rules.

risks.risk: Data inconsistencies between paper intake and electronic health records.
risks.mitigation: Define clear data entry responsibilities, add daily QC checks, and log discrepancies for follow-up.

risks.risk: Insufficient training leads to errors during peak hours.
risks.mitigation: Provide quick-reference guides, stagger training, and schedule on-site support during first week.

themes.why_relevant: Aligns front-desk, nursing, and quality roles on a single, auditable process.
Health data handling and consent must meet legal and institutional requirements.
New process only works if staff understand and adopt it consistently.
Regular checks and metrics ensure the process remains safe and efficient.
Clear communication at check-in and triage reduces anxiety and complaints.
Leveraging current EHR and office tools avoids extra cost and complexity.

backlog.task: Map current outpatient check-in and triage workflow across shifts
definition_of_done: All current steps from patient arrival to nurse triage documented
Variations by shift or day captured
Pain points and bottlenecks listed
Workflow map reviewed with specialist nurse and quality controller

backlog.task: Draft standardized patient intake and consent forms in two languages
definition_of_done: Draft forms created using existing templates where possible
Mandatory data fields and consent text included
Forms reviewed by specialist nurse for clinical relevance
Forms checked for data protection compliance by project stakeholders

backlog.task: Define triage protocol and escalation criteria for outpatient visits
definition_of_done: Triage categories and criteria documented
Escalation paths and response times defined
Protocol aligned with existing clinical guidelines
Protocol validated with head nurse or clinical lead

backlog.task: Design quality control checklist for daily process audits
definition_of_done: Checklist items cover key steps of check-in and triage
Compliance and data accuracy checks included
Scoring or pass/fail criteria defined
Checklist piloted on at least one shift and refined

backlog.task: Create staff training materials for front-desk and nursing teams
definition_of_done: Slide deck and quick-reference one-pagers prepared
Content tailored separately for admin and nursing staff
At least one short exercise or scenario included
Materials reviewed by specialist nurse and administrative assistant

backlog.task: Align new workflow with existing EHR data entry steps
definition_of_done: Required EHR fields for check-in and triage identified
Sequence of data entry steps documented
Any duplicate data entry removed where possible
Updated EHR usage notes shared with front-desk staff

backlog.task: Plan and schedule staff training sessions across shifts
definition_of_done: Training schedule drafted covering all shifts
Room or online meeting links booked
Invitations sent to all relevant staff
Attendance tracking method defined

backlog.task: Run pilot of new check-in and triage process for selected time window
definition_of_done: Pilot period and scope agreed with stakeholders
Front-desk and nursing staff briefed before pilot
Issues and incidents logged during pilot
Summary of pilot outcomes shared in channel

backlog.task: Set up daily quality audit routine using checklist
definition_of_done: Audit responsibilities assigned per shift
Checklist distribution and storage defined
First week of audits completed and logged
Recurring issues identified and shared with team

backlog.task: Document final standard operating procedure (SOP) for check-in and triage
definition_of_done: SOP includes step-by-step workflow and roles
Links to forms, EHR instructions, and QC checklist added
SOP reviewed by operations and quality stakeholders
Version control and review cycle defined

backlog.task: Prepare communication to patients about new check-in process
definition_of_done: Short patient-facing text drafted in two languages
Content reviewed by specialist nurse for clarity
Posters or digital signage formats defined
Approved text shared with front-desk for printing or upload

backlog.task: Create incident and improvement log for the new process
definition_of_done: Log template created and stored in shared location
Categories for incident and improvement suggestions defined
Team informed on how and when to record entries
First set of entries reviewed and summarized

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current workflow, main issues, and project scope before design work.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking everyone to share how check-in and triage currently work and main pain points.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the main objectives and success metrics for the new check-in and triage process.
Confirm which parts of the current workflow will remain unchanged during the first rollout.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Design and validate the new workflow, forms, and triage protocol.
threads_plan.trigger: Post initial drafts of the workflow map, intake forms, and triage protocol for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the structure and mandatory fields of the standardized intake and consent forms.
Approve the triage protocol and escalation criteria for outpatient visits.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define quality control approach and how audits and incidents will be handled.
threads_plan.trigger: Share first draft of the QC checklist and incident log template for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the daily audit routine, responsibilities, and minimum compliance threshold.
Decide how incidents and improvement suggestions will be logged and reviewed.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan training, communication, and pilot rollout details.
threads_plan.trigger: Post proposed training plan, SOP outline, and patient communication draft.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm training schedule, format, and which materials will be mandatory for each role.
Agree on pilot start date, scope, and patient communication channels.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in where each participant posts yesterday's progress, today's plan, and blockers.
Twice-weekly short review of incident and improvement log to agree on quick fixes.
Weekly summary message consolidating decisions, updated artifacts, and next priorities.
Pre-go-live readiness checklist review two days before pilot start.
Post-pilot retrospective thread to capture lessons learned and required SOP updates.
